input.title: Dispatch Loom
input.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
input.summary: Internal dispatch reconciliation tool for comparing an overnight spreadsheet with a daily export and surfacing understandable exceptions. Personally designed and built by Ada Rowan, who wrote the Python parser and SQL checks; coworkers also changed their checking habits, so the measured improvement was a team result. Operators kept empty rows visible because a blank reference could require a phone call, and late-arriving source files prompted a visible warning. The supervisor made the final dispatch decision.
input.source_quote: At Harbor Tools I personally designed and built Dispatch Loom, a dispatch reconciliation tool, using Python and SQL.
